# HTML Charts

> Free, copy-paste Chart.js charts for dashboard HTML containers. Each chart reads a normal grid on the same page and redraws it as a richer visual – no API, no data leaves the browser.

Built and maintained by Kai Jones, data analyst (CV: https://kaijxnes.com). Source: https://github.com/kaijxnes/HTML-Charts

How it works: add a grid with the chart's columns to the dashboard page, add an HTML container that runs JavaScript, paste the snippet. Charts look for generic headers (Month Key, Metric 1…, Dimension A…); map other names with data-columns='{"key":"Header"}' on the placeholder div. All demo data on the site is random.

## Charts

- [Monthly Bars](https://kaijxnes.github.io/HTML-Charts/monthly-bars.html): A $ metric by month as bars, with a toggle between three metrics, 6-month average cards and a second metric as a line. Script: https://kaijxnes.github.io/HTML-Charts/charts/monthly-bars-1.0.0.js
- [Stacked Segments](https://kaijxnes.github.io/HTML-Charts/stacked-segments.html): Metric × count by month, stacked by segment (any combination of three dimensions), with filters and a ranking. Script: https://kaijxnes.github.io/HTML-Charts/charts/stacked-segments-1.0.0.js
- [Segment Breakdown](https://kaijxnes.github.io/HTML-Charts/segment-breakdown.html): The stacked segment view for grids with the month first and two dimensions – starts on Dimension A, combine with Dimension C. Script: https://kaijxnes.github.io/HTML-Charts/charts/segment-breakdown-1.0.0.js
- [Cost vs Return](https://kaijxnes.github.io/HTML-Charts/cost-vs-return.html): A cost metric against return (count × value) by month: net return, ROI, cost per unit vs value per unit and a monthly table. Script: https://kaijxnes.github.io/HTML-Charts/charts/cost-vs-return-1.0.0.js
- [Month Heatmap](https://kaijxnes.github.io/HTML-Charts/month-heatmap.html): A heatmap of a $ metric by start month and month index – per month, cumulative or per unit – with every month's curve against the average. Script: https://kaijxnes.github.io/HTML-Charts/charts/month-heatmap-1.0.0.js
- [KPI Scorecard](https://kaijxnes.github.io/HTML-Charts/kpi-scorecard.html): Up to six metrics as cards with the latest value, change vs the previous month, a 3-month average or last year, and a sparkline; click one for its trend. Script: https://kaijxnes.github.io/HTML-Charts/charts/kpi-scorecard-1.0.0.js
- [Time Series Trio](https://kaijxnes.github.io/HTML-Charts/time-series-trio.html): Three metrics, each on its own row: a scorecard for the latest 7/28/90 days or months against the period before, next to a chart of all the data over time. Script: https://kaijxnes.github.io/HTML-Charts/charts/time-series-trio-1.0.0.js
- [Funnel](https://kaijxnes.github.io/HTML-Charts/funnel.html): Counts through ordered stages as a funnel, with step and overall conversion, the biggest drop-off and a conversion curve per segment. Script: https://kaijxnes.github.io/HTML-Charts/charts/funnel-1.0.0.js
- [Change Bridge](https://kaijxnes.github.io/HTML-Charts/change-bridge.html): A waterfall from one total to another, showing how much each item added or took away – e.g. last period to this period. Script: https://kaijxnes.github.io/HTML-Charts/charts/change-bridge-1.0.0.js
- [Pareto](https://kaijxnes.github.io/HTML-Charts/pareto.html): Items ranked largest first with a cumulative share line, showing how few items make up 80% of the total. Script: https://kaijxnes.github.io/HTML-Charts/charts/pareto-1.0.0.js
- [Target Pacing](https://kaijxnes.github.io/HTML-Charts/target-pacing.html): Month-to-date actual against target by day, with a month-end projection, % of target and the daily rate needed to hit it. Script: https://kaijxnes.github.io/HTML-Charts/charts/target-pacing-1.0.0.js
